Hi Olivia — great to hear the priorities. Drafted a concise MAP and acceptance harness below and attached a worksheet (MedIntel-MAP-v0.1.xlsx) with concrete checks you can run and owners for each item. High-level proposal:

1) Acceptance tests (concrete metrics)
- Latency: p95 <= 600ms for 99% of test windows (5 consecutive business days), measured on sandbox VPC using your 1k burst simulator.
- Cost: per-token cost delta compared to baseline < 1.2x (we'll instrument token accounting and share breakdown).
- Accuracy: weighted F1 >= 0.92 on your annotated eval set (2k examples).
- Safety: hallucination rate <= 3% on a curated 2k prompt sample; model responses pass our safety heuristic and your sample audits.

2) Exit gates (go/no-go)
- Go: All acceptance tests above passed for the required observation window AND no unresolved P1 incidents.
- Conditional go: One acceptance test marginally off (<=5% deviation) with documented mitigation and rollback plan approved by both parties.
- No-go: >1 test failing by >10% or security blocker (e.g., missing audit evidence).

3) Operational checks
- Audit logs: consolidated delivery of request/response logs for sandbox (redacted) + confirmation of KMS integration.
- Deployment: dedicated sandbox instance in your VPC for the two-week evaluation.
- Incident runbook: P1/P2 definitions and contact list (we'll provide template).

4) Timeline (proposed, 2 weeks)
- Day 0: MAP signed + test dataset and VPC access provided.
- Day 1–2: onboarding, baseline measurements, and smoke tests.
- Day 3–10: running acceptance tests and daily signal reports.
- Day 11–12: remediation window for minor gaps.
- Day 13–14: final run, evidence pack, and go/no-go decision meeting.

5) Owners
- Redwood: Jasmine (product/ops) for test orchestration, Ben (sales) for procurement cadence, Eng on-call for incident responses.
- MedIntel: Olivia (ops lead), Theo (security), Data owner (dataset and labels).

Attachments referenced: MedIntel-MAP-v0.1.xlsx (coverage matrix, test steps), sample eval harness pointer.

Next steps: if this looks good I can convert the worksheet into the formal MAP and send over a HubSpot link + shared drive folder. Are there any acceptance metrics you'd want tightened or relaxed?

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
